identity.description: Snowflake: cloud data platform (data warehouse, data lake, Cortex AI, and developer APIs), operated by Snowflake Inc. The assignment hint (docs.snowflake.com) matches the product.
identity.identity_notes: Docs describe the Snowflake REST APIs, SQL API, and Snowflake-managed MCP server for the Snowflake data platform. Matches the product named in the task.

auth.oauth_flows: Snowflake OAuth, with custom clients (confidential or public) configured via a security integration. Exact grant types not verified.
auth.scopes_notes: Snowflake-managed MCP server recommends OAuth for clients people sign in to; programmatic access tokens are the fallback. Per-tool permissions must be granted separately.

access.production_restrictions: Some features are restricted without a payment method (external network access, hybrid tables, Openflow capped at 10 credits/day; Cortex AI functions capped ~10 credits/day). Trial credits expire when the trial ends.

resources: Accounts, users, roles, database roles, grants
Tables (incl. dynamic, event, Iceberg), views, sequences
Snowpark Container Services: compute pools, image repositories, services
Cortex Embed, Cortex Inference, Cortex Search Service
Security, alerts, streams, tasks, integrations, tags
read_ops: Submit SQL statements for execution and check execution status (SQL API)
write_ops: CREATE OR ALTER for applicable resources (REST API)
Most DDL and DML statements via SQL API
api.limitations: Snowflake REST API coverage is not complete: 'not all resources in the API currently provide 100% coverage of their equivalent SQL commands.' Some resources unavailable in government regions. SQL API limitations apply to some statement types (page not fully read).

open_questions: SDKs: official client drivers (Python connector, Node.js, Go, JDBC, ODBC, .NET, Snowpark, Snowflake CLI) were not confirmed; the drivers docs URL returned 404 and no verbatim quote was obtained. Set to unknown.
Webhooks: no documented inbound/outbound webhook feature was found; set to unknown.
Rate limits for REST and SQL APIs were not established.
Whether the Snowflake-managed MCP server is still preview or fully GA was not confirmed on the fetched page (release note says GA Nov 04, 2025).

Snowflake-Labs/mcp is owned by Snowflake's own GitHub org, so it counts as official by ownership, but its README says it is deprecated and was reportedly archived; the managed server is the supported path. Other community MCP servers for Snowflake were not evaluated; community set to unknown.
OAuth grant types (authorization code vs. client credentials) and token refresh behavior were not verified from docs.
Sandbox availability beyond the trial account was not established.

Verbatim quote checks: most quotes were extracted by a summarizing fetch model and are marked unverified; search-snippet claims (trial terms, admin gate) need direct page fetches before production use.

assessment.approach: Wrap/benchmark vendor's official MCP server; add managed auth
rationale: Self-serve test credentials (trial self serve) and a documented REST interface.
